description: List the games a player has played in the last two weeks, with recent and total playtime, most-played-in-those-two-weeks first (capped at 50; check `returned` vs `total`) — the ordering is what decides which games the cap keeps, and it is playtime, not recency. For the all-time library by playtime instead (capped at 50 entries by default, either end of that ordering via `sort`), use get_owned_games. Requires STEAM_API_KEY and a public profile with game-details visibility (same requirement as get_owned_games). found:false means Steam returned no list, which it does for a hidden profile, a SteamID64 with no account, and some public profiles too, without saying why; `reason` names what narrows it down; for a public profile, nothing does.

steamid.description: 17-digit SteamID64. Omit to use the STEAM_ID configured on the server. Convert a vanity/custom URL name with resolve_vanity_url first.
